captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of two flat, thin, rectangular plates designed to function as a minimalist card holder or wallet. Each plate features shallow rectangular channels on its surface to guide rubber bands, along with small notches on the shorter ends to keep the bands securely in place. One of the long edges has a semi-circular thumb notch cut out to facilitate sliding cards out of the holder, and a small triangular tab or hub projects from the surface to assist in band retention.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable, parametric card holder wallet consisting of two plates. The plates should be rectangular with dimensions slightly larger than a credit card, featuring notches on the short ends for rubber bands, a thumb notch on one side to slide cards out, guiding grooves on the surface, and a small raised hub. Allow customization of the plate thickness, margin sizes, and text lines to be embedded on the plates using the Write.scad library.
captions.factory: The script defines a base 'shape' module which starts with a flat 'cube' representing the card holder plate. It uses a 'difference' operation to cut out rectangular notches at both ends using 'cube', a thumb notch on the side using 'cylinder', and shallow guiding grooves on the top surface using thin 'cube' primitives. A small 'cylinder' is translated and added to form a raised hub. The 'face' module uses the 'write' library to place three customizable lines of text on the surface, and the final assembly mirrors and translates two instances of this plate to create the front and back covers.
